# `aitbc trade discover`

Discover trading offers across chains with optional filters.

## Usage

```bash
aitbc trade discover [OPTIONS]
```

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--source-chain` | text | — | no | Filter by source chain |
| `--dest-chain` | text | — | no | Filter by destination chain |
| `--service-type` | text | — | no | Filter by service type (e.g. gpu_market) |
| `--min-price` | float | — | no | Minimum price filter |
| `--max-price` | float | — | no | Maximum price filter |
| `--region` | text | — | no | Filter by region |
| `--gpu-model` | text | — | no | Filter by GPU model |
| `--limit` | integer | `100` | no | Max results |
| `--format` | choice | — | no | Output format |

## Examples

```bash
aitbc trade discover
```
